课程简介（中文）

从知觉出发介绍人的认知特点；分析有效沟通应考虑的三大原则；在讨论对人对己看法，得出 ‘We are OK !’是可以持续、学习的生活态度的基础上；介绍三大沟通技能，分别是：你/我信息（换位思考式沟通）；自信表达和积极倾听。课程还将讨论人际冲突产生的原因、说服的理论和技能、谈判中的价值创造和索取策略，倾听言外之意、动作表情识别、演讲、有效与自己对话等内容。通过学习，达到系统认识和掌握管理沟通的理论和技能。

课程简介（英文）

The course begins with perception to introduce the characteristics of human cognition and then examines three key principles of effective communication. Through discussions of how we view ourselves and others, students will explore the idea that “We are OK!” represents a sustainable and learnable attitude toward life. Building on this foundation, the course introduces three core communication skills: You/I messages (perspective-taking communication), assertive expression, and active listening.

The course will also cover the causes of interpersonal conflict, theories and techniques of persuasion, strategies for creating and claiming value in negotiation, listening beyond words, recognizing nonverbal cues such as gestures and facial expressions, public speaking, and effective self-communication. Through the course, students will develop a systematic understanding of the theories and skills of management communication and learn how to apply them effectively.

教学目标

沟通是人类社会的基本生活方式，是人们通过共同的符号系统进行意见或思想交流的过程。沟通是管理过程的重要组成部分。杰克·韦尔奇（GE前CEO）曾说过:“管理就是沟通，沟通，再沟通。”本课程介绍管理沟通策略的原理和运用方式。
